```python import re import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.soundgasm import SoundgasmIE class DummySoundgasmIE(SoundgasmIE): """Subclass that overrides network calls to return a controlled HTML page.""" def __init__(self, html): super().__init__() self._html = html def _download_webpage(self, url, display_id, note=None, errnote=None, *, fatal=True): # Return the predefined HTML regardless of the URL return self._html def test_soundgasm_extraction_success(): # Construct a minimal HTML page that satisfies all regexes html = """ Test
Piano sample
Royalty Free Sample Music
""" extractor = DummySoundgasmIE(html) url = "http://soundgasm.net/u/ytdl/Piano-sample" result = extractor.extract(url) assert result["id"] == "88abd86ea000cafe98f96321b23cc1206cbcbcc9" assert result["display_id"] == "Piano-sample" assert result["url"] == "https://cdn.soundgasm.net/audio/88abd86ea000cafe98f96321b23cc1206cbcbcc9.m4a" assert result["vcodec"] == "none" assert result["title"] == "Piano sample" assert result["description"] == "Royalty Free Sample Music" assert result["uploader"] == "ytdl" def test_soundgasm_missing_description(): # HTML without a description element html = """
Piano sample
""" extractor = DummySoundgasmIE(html) url = "http://soundgasm.net/u/ytdl/Piano-sample" result = extractor.extract(url) assert result["description"] is None # description is optional def test_soundgasm_invalid_url_raises(): extractor = DummySoundgasmIE("") # URL that does not match the VALID_URL pattern should raise a ValueError with pytest.raises(ValueError): extractor.extract("http://invalidsite.com/u/ytdl/Piano-sample") ```
